evidence_excerpts: Dimidjian and Segal estimate that only 30% of research using mindfulness-based interventions has moved beyond Stage 1; 20% was Stage 2a, 9% Stage 2b, and only 1% outside research contexts.
MBIs compared to active controls were found to have a mixture of only moderate, low, or no efficacy, depending on the disorder being treated.
text: Clinical evidence for mindfulness-based interventions remains preliminary because much intervention research has not advanced beyond early-stage efficacy designs and often lacks active controls or real-world practice tests.
